modules.title: AI 工具配置文件对照
配置文件和项目规则分别负责什么

items.title: 配置文件保存运行设置（JSON / YAML / TOML）
items.text: 用于保存 Provider、模型、地址、端口或权限等运行参数。常见格式有 JSON（严格键值对）、YAML（可写注释）和 TOML（分块清晰）。

items.title: 项目规则规范协作要求
items.text: 项目规则用于说明模型在当前项目中需要遵守的要求，例如技术栈、代码风格和协作规范。

items.title: 修改配置后通常需要重启
items.text: 多数工具只在启动时读取配置文件。修改 next.config.js、.env 或 tailwind.config.ts 后，通常要重启开发服务器（Ctrl+C 再 npm run dev）才能生效。

lessonPractice.title: 模型调用失败时，应该先查看什么类型的文件？

options.label: 配置文件
options.feedback: 对。模型调用失败时，应先检查配置文件中的 Provider、模型和连接设置。

options.label: 项目规则文件
options.feedback: 不对。模型调用失败时，应先检查配置文件中的 Provider、模型和连接设置。

options.label: 页面样式文件
options.feedback: 不对。模型调用失败时，应先检查配置文件中的 Provider、模型和连接设置。

en.title: What type of file should you check first when a model call fails?

options.label: The config file
options.feedback: Correct. First check the Provider, model, and connection settings in the config file.

options.label: The project rules file
options.feedback: Not quite. First check the Provider, model, and connection settings in the config file.

options.label: The page style file
options.feedback: Not quite. First check the Provider, model, and connection settings in the config file.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先确认当前工具实际读取哪一个配置文件，再检查模型、连接地址和超时设置。不要读取或打印真实密钥；完成后告诉我生效的文件路径和配置层级。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First identify which config file this tool actually loads, then check its model, endpoint, and timeout settings. Do not read or print real secrets; report the effective path and configuration layer.

learning.assumes: You know that an AI tool needs a model service.
learning.outcome: You can distinguish the config's platform and model choice from the way the model should work under project rules.

modules.title: What do a config file and project rules each control?

items.title: Config files store runtime settings (JSON / YAML / TOML)
items.text: Stores provider, model, endpoint, port, or permission parameters. Common formats include JSON (strict key-value), YAML (supports comments), and TOML (clear sections).

items.title: Project rules specify collaboration requirements
items.text: Project rules describe the constraints and conventions the model must follow in the current codebase, such as stack, code style, and boundaries.

items.title: Restart usually required after changes
items.text: Most tools only read configs on startup. Modifying next.config.js, .env, or tailwind.config.ts usually requires restarting the dev server (Ctrl+C then npm run dev).

distinctions.label: Project Rules
distinctions.text: A {c:config-file} configures the tool's runtime settings (such as model, Base URL, or timeout); {c:project-rules} instruct the AI on coding conventions and project constraints.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: First identify which config file this tool actually loads, then check its model, endpoint, and timeout settings. Do not read or print real secrets; report the effective path and configuration layer.
